201.content: At the library puppet afternoon in 2012, Owen and I performed a paper-dragon play. The curtain jammed before we finished. Aunt Leah held up a stripy bedsheet instead. Owen called it our royal theatre curtain. Later we visited the café and shared a slice of plum cake.

301.title: Orchard pond afternoon
301.content: At the community orchard in 2018, Ellis and I floated paper boats on the pond. Ellis’s boat sank beside the reeds. Instead of racing my boat, I used it to bring back the little paper flag. Ellis called that the world’s shortest rescue voyage. We ate pear tart afterward.

501.content: At the scout storeroom in 1994, Jun and I built a wooden shelf. Jun measured the wall twice, but we cut the boards too short. We joined two spare offcuts to make the shelf reach the brackets. Jun called it our shelf with an extra elbow. We painted a storage box green afterward.
